title: Geometry relaxation and lattice constants
action: Perform DFT geometry relaxation for six trigonal II–IV–N₂ monolayers (ZnSiN₂, ZnGeN₂, ZnSnN₂, CdSiN₂, CdGeN₂, CdSnN₂) using GGA-PBE, ONCVPSP pseudopotentials, and appropriate k‑point sampling. Use an orthorhombic unit cell with a vacuum of 10 Å along the c direction. Extract the relaxed lattice constants a and b (in Å).
description: JSON array of 6 objects, each with compound name and the equilibrium lattice constants a and b.
output_schema: Array of objects; each object has keys: 'compound' (string, e.g. 'ZnSiN2'), 'a' (number, Å), 'b' (number, Å).

title: Phonon stability analysis
action: Using the relaxed structures from step 1, compute phonon dispersions via DFPT (with LO‑TO splitting) along high‑symmetry paths. Determine the minimum phonon frequency (negative values indicate imaginary modes). Record the minimum frequency and a boolean stability flag (true if min ≥ 0, false if min < 0).
description: JSON array of 6 objects, each with compound name, minimum phonon frequency, and stability flag.
output_schema: Array of objects; each object has keys: 'compound' (string), 'min_phonon_frequency' (number, cm⁻¹, negative = imaginary), 'stable' (boolean).

title: Band gap calculation
action: Compute electronic band structures for all six monolayers using DFT‑GGA‑PBE with appropriate k‑point paths. Extract the direct band gap at Γ and the indirect band gap from the valence band maximum to Γ. Determine the gap type: 'direct' if VBM at Γ, else 'indirect'.
description: JSON array of 6 objects, each with compound name, direct gap, indirect gap, and gap type.
output_schema: Array of objects; each object has keys: 'compound' (string), 'direct_gap' (number, eV, Γ→Γ), 'indirect_gap' (number, eV, VBM→Γ), 'gap_type' (string, 'direct' or 'indirect').

title: Strain-induced band gap transition for ZnSnN₂
action: Starting from relaxed ZnSnN₂, apply uniaxial compressive strain on lattice constant b (reduce b, relax atomic positions at each strain) and compute the band structure for strains: 0%, −0.05%, −0.1%, −0.15%, −0.2%, −0.25%, −0.3%, −0.35%, −0.4%, −0.45%, −0.5%. For each strain, report the direct gap at Γ and the indirect gap (X→Γ).
description: JSON array of objects, each with strain fraction, direct gap, and indirect gap. At zero strain indirect gap should be smaller; beyond the transition strain direct gap becomes smaller.
output_schema: Array of objects; each object has keys: 'strain_b' (number, strain as decimal, e.g. −0.001 for −0.1%), 'direct_gap' (number, eV), 'indirect_gap' (number, eV).
